ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.6:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) zones dominate the lateral lobes; a central low-intensity (black) band extends from the base to the posterior margin; scattered low-intensity punctate spots (diameter < 20 pixels) are distributed across the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes of 5-25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex anterior boundary curve tapering into sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered circular white rings (5-15 pixel diameter) in the central black pigmentation zone; high-intensity clusters at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct parallel dark linear streaks (~140 pixels length) on the left lateral lobe; one dark linear streak (~90 pixels length) on the right lateral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) attached to the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'S'-shaped high-intensity pixel mark located within the lower-central black pigmentation region.
